actors.name: Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local
actors.private_context: The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. A rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The local has not yet decided whether to endorse the port automation memorandum or to issue a press release.

shared_context: The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The local can issue a press release at any time before Monday. The port automation memorandum is a known topic of discussion.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No press release has been issued yet by the local.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the local actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating its endorsement or non-endorsement of the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
